articles.summary: Forget feature checklists. Evaluate headless CMS platforms using the four criteria that actually matter: self-hosting, multi-tenancy, AI readiness, and total cost of ownership.
articles.title: How to Choose a Headless CMS in 2026: The Criteria That Actually Decide | Webiny

articles.summary: Learn how to choose the best CMS for managing multiple client websites by comparing single-tenant, SaaS, and native multi-tenant architectures based on scalability, isolation, deployment, and long-term cost. Discover which approach works best for agencies as their client portfolio grows, what features actually matter at scale, and why multi-tenancy can dramatically reduce operational overhead while improving profitability.
articles.title: How to Choose a CMS When You're Running Client Sites at Scale | Webiny
